title: Figma to code: what came back, the token link, and whether Figma mock-ups are the way

chat.text: A script inventories every Figma design against the code pages that implement it, and every code page the Figma agents built, with two counts that must agree; a Figma-variable to browser-token map is written and shown on the tokens page; the Figma masterminds are asked directly what they pushed and need. Your question, is Figma mock-up the way, gets an inbox note with the trade-off and a recommendation.
